title: Last Stone Weight
statement: You are given an array of integers stones representing stone weights. Repeatedly smash the two heaviest stones together: if they are equal both are destroyed, otherwise the lighter is destroyed and the heavier becomes the difference. Return the weight of the last remaining stone, or 0 if none remain.
hints: Use a max-heap (negate values for Python's min-heap) to always grab the two heaviest stones.
Push the difference back onto the heap when the two stones are unequal.
Stop when at most one stone remains.
